LESSON: WRITING 11.4.1 GUIDED WRITING

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.4: Writing 11.4.1 Guided Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 11.4.1 Guided Writing, part of Strand 11 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to correctly write names of objects?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Name different objects in pictures provided.

2. Respond to the prompts presented and write names of objects.

3. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication.

4. Draw/trace/stamp, colour and name the objects related to the theme, with peers. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use adapted drawing and colouring tools and materials,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Name different objects in pictures provided.
2. Respond to the prompts presented and write names of objects.
3. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication.
4. Draw/trace/stamp, colour and name the objects related to the theme, with peers. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use adapted drawing and colouring tools and materials,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 11.4.1 Guided Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Creativity and imagination- learner’s ability to explore new ideas is enhanced as they draw objects, colour them and respond

to picture prompts.

Values:
Unity: Cooperation is enhanced as the learner collaborates with others in group activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life Skills (self- esteem) learner’s esteem is nurtured as they name objects correctly.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Naming objects is taught in Kiswahili and Indigenous Language Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Picture, assistive technology such as universal cuffs/wrist braces/arm braces, weighted pencil/pen grips, adapted drawing tools

and materials, page-turners, adapted digital devices
